messages:
Ana: quick design review — thinking through chart affordances for metrics dashboard:
Ana: - unit toggle (ms / p50 / p95 / %) with persistent preference
Ana: - mini-sparkline overlay for route-level rows (hover reveals full chart)
Ana: - outlier sentinels: show faint markers and a 'View spike' CTA instead of stretching the y-axis
Ana: - smoothing expressed as a band (min/max/median shaded area) rather than only a smoothed line
Ana: - screen-reader summary sentence and a data-download link for each chart

Kris: frontend constraints: love the sparkline idea but perf is a concern for ~400 rows. can we lazy-render? :thinking:
Kris: we can do canvas batching + intersection observer. prototype snippet below:
Kris: ```js
Kris: // lazy render sparklines
Kris: const obs = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
Kris:   entries.forEach(e => { if (e.isIntersecting) renderCanvas(e.target) })
Kris: })
Kris: rows.forEach(r => obs.observe(r))
Kris: ```
Kris: also proposing an adaptive tick formatter: when unit is ms we show 0.1 precision under 10ms, otherwise integers.

Sam: product +1 on prioritization:
Sam: 1) outlier sentinels (stop axis blowouts)
Sam: 2) unit toggle persistence and clearer label
Sam: 3) sparkline perf work (lazy + batch)
Sam: microcopy tweak: use label 'Display as' for the unit toggle — less ambiguous than 'Units'.

Nisha: accessibility checks / quick notes:
Nisha: - sparklines must have accessible name or be aria-hidden if decorative; provide a summary text for screen readers.
Nisha: - outlier CTA should be keyboard-focusable and include SR text like 'View 2 spikes between Mar 1–3'.
Nisha: - smoothing band needs a legend label and keyboard toggle to turn smoothing on/off.
Nisha: - for color contrast, test the band fill at 4.5:1 against background.

Ana: design note: responsive breakpoint — hide sparkline under 720px and show a compact delta % instead.
Ana: mock (wip): https://figma.com/file/EXAMPLE (will update before sync)

Kris: idea: add an 'compress outliers' advanced toggle for power users — preserves context but rescales spikes into a sentinel area with a tooltip.
Kris: implementation: compute IQR clip and render clipped points with a cap marker; tooltip shows original values and an inline link to expand the full axis.

Sam: product approves 'compress outliers' as an advanced setting behind the gear menu; default off.
